title: AI Readiness Assessment for Indian SMBs
description: Evaluate your business's readiness to leverage Artificial Intelligence for improved operational efficiency, cost savings, and increased profits.

sections.title: Business Vision & AI Alignment
sections.description: How well is AI integrated into your overall business strategy and profit goals?

questions.text: We have a clearly defined business strategy that accounts for digital and AI-driven opportunities.

options.text: Working plan exists for one department
AI is embedded in our company-wide strategy

questions.text: Our leadership team actively discusses and sponsors AI initiatives.
We track metrics related to operational efficiency and profitability at least monthly.

sections.title: Operational Data & Infrastructure Readiness
sections.description: Evaluation of your existing data quality, IT infrastructure, and data security practices.

questions.text: Our business data (customer, sales, inventory) is digitised and stored centrally.

options.text: Mostly paper-based or siloed in individual files
Some data digitised, spread across scattered tools
Clean, structured data in a centralised system

questions.text: Our IT infrastructure is reliable and scalable for new technologies.

options.text: Modern, scalable, with redundancy and security layers

questions.text: We have documented cybersecurity and data backup protocols in place.

options.text: Comprehensive policy including encryption and incident response

sections.title: Team & Culture for AI Adoption
sections.description: Assessment of your team's readiness, skills, and organisational culture to embrace AI-driven changes.

questions.text: Our team members have basic digital literacy (using cloud apps, collaboration tools).

options.text: Most of the team is comfortable with new technology
Team actively seeks out and adopts new digital tools

questions.text: Our organisation encourages experimentation and learning.

options.text: Learning is encouraged but no budget for it
Budget exists for training and pilot projects
Dedicated innovation time and resources allocated

questions.text: We understand which internal processes would benefit most from automation or AI.

options.text: No clarity on potential use cases
Mapped all processes and prioritised by ROI

sections.title: High-Impact AI Use Cases & Opportunities
sections.description: Identification of potential AI applications relevant to driving operational efficiency and direct business profits.

questions.text: We have repetitive manual tasks that consume more than 20% of our team's time.

options.text: Automated workflows cover back-office and customer-facing processes

questions.text: We currently use any AI-powered tools (chatbots, predictive analytics, automation).

options.text: AI tools deployed across multiple business functions

questions.text: We can clearly identify where a small efficiency gain would have a big impact on profitability.

options.text: Some bottlenecks known, no solution identified
Ready to implement targeted automation for high-ROI processes

sections.title: AI Governance & Data Privacy (DPDP Act)
sections.description: Awareness and preparedness for AI ethics, data privacy, and responsible AI implementation.

questions.text: We understand how the DPDP Act impacts our data collection and customer communication.

options.text: Aware but no compliance actions taken
Basic privacy policy and consent mechanisms in place

questions.text: We have clear policies for responsible and ethical use of AI.
We are confident that our data handling practices will not create legal or reputational risk.
